programme.title: Labour's Local Election Wipeout Analysed
programme.desc: Laura and Seán analyse the 2026 local elections, examining the winners and losers as Labour's poor form continues. Reform achieved significant gains with a landslide in councils across the country, whilst the Greens made notable wins in Hackney and Edinburgh. In Wales, Labour's First Minister failed to gain reelection as the party's troubles deepen. The question remains whether Keir Starmer can survive.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. Alex is promoting his annual Comedy Football Trophy match taking place at Chesham United, featuring some of the biggest names in comedy playing for a great cause.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: CANDES & MILAN
programme.desc: An idyllic Hawaiian island provides the perfect setting for a romantic tropical wedding between a former Miss Hawaii and a European chef. Nature and elegance are contrasted by adorning the cliff-side ceremony with décor and flowers in blush pink, light green and gold. Hundreds of crystal strands rain down to make the reception tent shimmer. Guests are treated to a main course created by the groom, while the bride amazes her guests with a gorgeous mermaid silhouette wedding gown.

programme.title: MARIA & CHRIS
programme.desc: Maria and Chris celebrate their nuptials with multiple events at the highly secluded and private South Seas Island Resort off the coast of Florida. Pre-ceremony events include a golf tournament for their guests, afternoon spa treatments, and an exotic Caribbean themed welcome party. The wedding itself is Chic Island Elegance, with green and white décor and amber lighting. Orchid chandeliers, glittering carved ice elements, and a Miami club themed after party captivate their guests.

programme.title: CHRISTINE & JONATHAN
programme.desc: All brides should be as fortunate as Christine. When she can't find the perfect chapel for her wedding to Jonathan, her father builds her one! And he doesn't stop there. He creates an entire $4 million wedding village, including a high-tech reception ballroom, a perfect courtyard for cocktail hour, luxe suites for the bridal party, and even a jewelry store and a spa for pre-wedding pampering. For Christine's special day, she and her designer fill the ballroom and chapel with a romantic secret garden look, highlighted by manzanita wood centerpieces dripping with hydrangeas and orchids. The evening is rounded out with gourmet dinner stations and a whimsical “Mad hatter” style wedding cake.

programme.title: ANISHA & KENNARD
programme.desc: When the daughter of baseball Hall of Famer Tony Gwynn marries a young ball player, the celebration is bound to be a home run! The bride proudly ties all aspects of her wedding to the family's love of the game. In a nod to the baseball diamond, she exclusively wears diamond jewelry – $1.35 million worth! Throughout the ceremony and reception are dozens of dramatic, large, pavé yellow rose balls, evoking the image of baseballs. The cocktail hour noshes are glammed-up ball game food like Kobe beef sliders and petite French fries made with truffle oil. The groom's cake fits the theme to a T, looking so much like an actual baseball glove that it's almost a shame to eat it.

programme.title: NAOMI & GEORGE
programme.desc: The guests of a Black Eyed Peas guitarist and a Hollywood hairstylist are in for an adventure of a lifetime when the couple whisks them away to Mexico. They have several events planned at the lush Xcaret eco park, from a rocking welcome party to swimming with sharks, to the wedding itself. The ceremony has a very Spanish feel in its ancient open-air chapel, complete with bridesmaids in purple charmeuse gowns and red roses in their hair flanking the gorgeous bride with a custom peineta holding her veil in place. It's followed by an incredible reception in a cave that's vibrantly decked out in reds and purples.

programme.title: NATALIE & BOB
programme.desc: A library has never looked as breathtaking as Sacramento's Tsakopoulos Library looks decked out in Natalie and Bob's wedding décor. The soaring space is draped in 48-yard-long panels of red fabric, and underneath are exquisite tablescapes of silver-edged place settings and centerpieces created from 20 types of red flowers. This fun-loving couple makes the most of their preparations, with a gourmet food tasting to narrow down their menu, and a decadent wine and chocolate tasting party with their friends. The bride makes a foray into an exclusive jewelry store that results in $1 million of wedding day glam.

programme.title: CRISTINA & JORGE
programme.desc: Two elements characterize the wedding of Cristina and Jorge: their Cuban heritage and perfectly executed pops of color. It's important to the couple that the food is incredible, and since they're in South Beach, Florida, their chef incorporates Cuban spices and fruits into a steak and lobster dinner to create a modern “Floribbean” feast. The décor has an elegant, clean look with a lot of black and white, while drama comes from fuchsia accents. Crystal-filled vases are topped with a stunning cube-shaped design of 600 bright pink double dianthus flowers per centerpiece. And the wedding cake is one-of-a-kind: layers of cake draped in black fondant fronted with fuchsia and white rectangles alternate with layers of acrylic boxes filled with crystals!

programme.title: Swamp Bride
programme.desc: What is David Tutera to do with a bride who is allergic to flowers and wants her wedding décor to resemble a swamp? This is a first for David, and with only three weeks until the wedding, he's going to either sink or swim. His first challenge is to get his head strong bride to agree to change out her wedding gown. Not easy. And as for the bridesmaid's dresses that look like lily pads? Oh yes, they are second to go! Since David's bride has such a unique vision for her big day, he's on a quest for one-of-a-kind wedding favors. Favors that have to include frogs – yes, frogs. And finally, it's time to face the challenge of what food to serve at this wedding, so what better than a yummy food tasting. And when the big day finally arrives, our bride has all of Manhattan as a backdrop and fireworks to finalize a magical day.

programme.title: Diva Bride
programme.desc: They say everything is bigger in Texas, and so is the personality of David Tutera's new Dallas bride. When she says “diva”, you better say ‘licious” , because she's a force to be reckoned with. How do you combine Lady Gaga, Beyonce, Mardi Gras and pink feathers into a wedding? With three weeks until the big day, David decides to make everything off the charts! Glittery, glamorous reception dresses for not only the bride but the bridesmaids as well. And nothing says “diva” like an over-the-top photo shoot! And what better location for this production, than a theater complete with a red carpet entrance!

programme.title: Cowgirl Bride
programme.desc: With many brides, the dress is the most important thing for her wedding. But with David Tutera's next bride – it's all about the cowboy boots! This Texas cowgirl is dead set on two stepping her way into the sunset, and David is determined to have her step into a pair of nice heels! The challenges start with giving the bride a sophisticated gown to wear – with or without boots! And speaking of boots, how about bridal boot camp to get into shape for the big day? A picture-perfect Texas ranch transforms into the ideal setting for our country bride to dance the night away under the stars.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

Deep in the desert he manages to come close to the last Wild Ass, so called Onager. The horse like animals are very shy and rare. Near the mystical forest of Persia the journey ends at the biggest inland lake of the world: the Caspian Sea. There Benny stalks on the pink flamingoes which gather there for feeding. programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Cheat Code
programme.desc: Competing over who can ask Zoey to join their Sheep Week team, Logan cheats and unwittingly endangers the video game based Cyber Realm.

programme.title: The Bigger Picture
programme.desc: When the kids meddle in their teacher's dream to find test answers, they realize that in dreams, sweet little Ms. Putnam isn't so sweet... or little!

programme.title: Beasts And Dragons, Rise Of Garmadon
programme.desc: Zane, Jay, and Kai remember some of Ninjago's fearsome creatures so that Cole defend the cave from an unidentified monster. But Ninja confront memories of their greatest villain and ally, Garmadon, before the threat to Zane controls him completely.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. programme.title: Summer Exposure
programme.desc: On the tiny resort island of Martha's Vineyard, landscaper, Patrick Ryer, suffers from chills and high fever. Patrick has contracted Tularemia, a rare bacterial disease. Health officials alert residents and tourists who crowd the Vineyard over the summer holiday. Over the next month, ten more people are diagnosed with the disease, including other landscapers and children. Medical investigators from the Center for Disease Control and state officials search for a common link. Tularemia is so infectious that it is on the government's watch list of biological weapons. Based on the number of people infected, officials quickly rule out terrorism, but none of the cases appear to be related. All they are able to determine is that most of the victims have outdoor occupations such as landscaping and construction. The findings mark the first time landscaping has been named as a risk factor for the disease.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: AGNI VAYU
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.307
programme.desc: In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.308
programme.desc: BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals.In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi's Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.310
programme.desc: Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other's respective universes. Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin!Tune in to I'm LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong's own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.”

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: BHARAT RATNA THE JEWELS OF INDIA
programme.desc: Bharat Ratna The Jewels of India is a show that celebrates the recipients of India's highest civilian honour. Through the medium of graphics and information, the show, intends to exhibit hidden unknown and loved stories from lives of these legendary characters.

programme.title: EPIC KE DUS
programme.desc: Epic Ke Dus is a halfhour collated list of the top ten people, places or events of a chosen topic, examples of which include rivalries, thinkers and warriors. Each topic has been thoroughly researched and a panel of experts on the subject has carefully selected the stories that are fitting to be part of the topic. This panel is seen on the episodes giving their views on the events, the significance of the event and describing the mood of the era, publics reaction to these events and how it contributed to change the course of Indian history.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: UMEED INDIA
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: Le Motorizzate
programme.desc: Divertente film ad episodi interpretato da Totò, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello e altri famosissimi attori. Si susseguono: una suora dalla guida spericolata una mondana che vive su una roulotte uno sportivo che rifiuta il passaggio offertogli da una bella motorizzata un falso vigile che intasca svariate multe e uno squattrinato che si lascia investire sperando di ricavare un grosso guadagno.

programme.title: Basta con la guerra… facciamo l'amore
programme.desc: Lo zio di un seminarista decide che il nipote dev'essere spinto a esplorare l'interesse verso le donne e, per aiutarlo, si fa assistere dalla moglie e dalla cameriera.

programme.title: Gli amici di Nick Hezard
programme.desc: Per vendicare la morte del suo amico, un giovane lestofante in Svizzera predispone un'ingegnosa truffa ai danni del principale responsabile, un affarista americano. Gli fa credere di esser stato coinvolto in un omicidio e fa in modo di sottrargli una grossa quantità di denaro. L'attuazione del piano, però, non sarà affatto semplice.

programme.title: Milano rovente
programme.desc: Salvatore Cangemi, proprietario di una società di ortofrutta di giorno e magnaccia di notte, viene minacciato dall'apparizione di uno spietato gangster francese chiamato Le Capitaine che vuole unire il crimine organizzato a Milano per ottenere tutti i profitti. Totò non ha intenzione di far parte dell'organizzazione di Le Capitaine, e la loro rivalità causa una sanguinosa guerra tra bande.

programme.title: Telefoni Bianchi
programme.desc: Nel vivace affresco diretto da Dino Risi, una giovane impiegata sogna di diventare attrice e entrare nel brillante ma ipocrita mondo del cinema dei "telefoni bianchi". Tra ambizioni, compromessi e seduzioni, scopre quanto sia fragile il confine tra successo e illusione. Risi offre una satira acuta sull'ascesa sociale e sul fascino ingannevole dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
programme.desc: La vita di Paolo (Marcello Mastroianni), un tranquillo e indolente autista di taxi, viene sconvolta dall'incontro con Lina (Sophia Loren), una bella ragazza, abile in borseggi e piccole truffe. Lina e la sua famiglia, sconclusionata come lei, affascinano Paolo che ce la mette tutta per redimere la ragazza. Con Vittorio De Sica nei panni del Prof. Stroppiani, padre di Lina.

programme.title: La fortuna di essere donna
programme.desc: Antonietta (Sophia Loren), una giovane di famiglia modesta, diventa per caso una ragazza copertina. Corrado, il fotografo che l'ha scoperta, si innamora e lei lo fa ingelosire frequentando il conte Senetti, il quale le insegna le buone maniere. Il nobile le regala una pelliccia e le promette di sposarla, ma presto si farà viva una persona che porterà scompiglio.

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: Una divertentissima commedia con due icone del cinema italiano, Totò e Sophia Loren. Due famiglie povere vivono sotto lo stesso tetto e i due rispettivi capifamiglia si arrangiano come possono. Un giorno però la fortuna sembra averli baciati: si presenta un marchese che gli chiede un favore molto particolare. Tratta dall'omonima opera teatrale di Eduardo Scarpetta.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Belly
programme.desc: Lilly, una giovane rimasta orfana da bambina mentre era in Africa, arriva nel Regno Unito, patria dei genitori, da rifugiata per fuggire dalla guerra civile. Lilly diventerà una presenza importante nella comunità degli immigrati che vivono a Londra e cercherà di riunire famiglie divise dai conflitti. La sua amica Amina scopre, però, che Lilly ha una storia d'amore con Aziz, un medico idealista.

programme.title: Bergman 100: La Vita, I Segreti, Il Genio
programme.desc: Il documentario ricostruisce un anno fondamentale nella vita di Ingmar Bergman, il maestro del cinema, focalizzandosi sugli eventi che segnarono la sua carriera, tra l'uscita di Il posto delle fragole e Il settimo sigillo. Un viaggio nella sua arte, i suoi segreti e il suo genio creativo.

programme.title: La strega
programme.desc: In Svezia, l'ingegnere francese Laurent Brulard, un imprenditore forestale in una regione isolata, riscontra delle difficoltà nel suo lavoro e nella sua vita quotidiana quando si imbatte in un mondo di superstizione. Ciò nonostante, è sostenuto dalla proprietaria del terreno Kristina, con cui collabora e che gli ama.

programme.title: UN ANNO PER CAMBIARE
programme.desc: Dopo esser caduto da un tetto alla festa di Capodanno ed essere sopravvissuto, Owen decide che è il momento di cambiare vita. Obiettivi principali: innamorarsi e rientrare in contatto col figlio

programme.title: CHEERLEADER PERICOLOSE
programme.desc: Maisy si trasferisce nel college dov'è morta sua sorella per scoprire la verità: scopre così che molte cheerleader hanno un secondo lavoro che potrebbe collegare molti indizi

programme.title: SCANDALO AL COLLEGE
programme.desc: Annie e Katie sono migliori amiche da sempre e il loro sogno è quello di frequentare il college di Pine State. Il loro sogno, però, deve scontrarsi con la realtà: non hanno i voti abbastanza alti per entrare in graduatoria. Qui parte il piano di riscatto, sono pronte a tutto pur di entrare perfino pagare altri per sostenere l'esame al posto loro. Quella che, però, sembra una semplice truffa d'identità, in realtà, si trasforma ben presto in un incubo con tanto di uccisioni e vite messe in pericolo.

programme.title: 10 YEARS
programme.desc: Channing Tatum e il temuto momento della verità: la reunion dopo 10 anni coi compagni del liceo. Chi ha avuto successo? Chi ha cambiato vita? Chi è ancorato nel passato? Un cast stellare e l'ultima possibilità per mettere da parte vecchie ferite o riaprire amori in sospeso nel tempo. Gelosie, insicurezze, rivincite il tutto mischiato con una maturità solo apparente.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs e Octopus accettano un lavoro dal loro padrone di casa, in cambio di una lauta ricompensa: rapire un bambino. Ben presto, il bebè risveglia forti sentimenti paterni nei due truffatori, portando a complicazioni quando si tratta di riconsegnarlo.

programme.title: Chiedi Alla Polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Fong è un ladro che ha il vizio del gioco. L'occasione per fare un po' di soldi si presenta quando un magnate gli offre l'incarico di rapire un bambino. L'uomo accetta, ma l'unico problema è che deve prendersi cura del piccolo per qualche giorno.

programme.title: Cloud Atlas
programme.desc: Sei storie attraverso i secoli. Una sola anima. Tom Hanks e Halle Berry spiccano in un cast stellare, in un intreccio di storie tra passato, presente e futuro. Quando i personaggi si incontrano tra una vita e l'altra, le loro azioni generano delle conseguenze.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite, instillando l'amore, la sensibilità e la paura in chi ne viene colpito. In tale contesto, i giovani Nia e Silas vivranno sulla loro pelle i dilemmi generati da una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: La mappa dell'amore
programme.desc: Un giornalista in procinto di lanciare un'app di incontri ha il compito di scrivere una mappa dei luoghi più romantici della Florida. L'unico problema è che deve collaborare con una guida turistica i cui gusti sono diametralmente opposti ai suoi.

programme.title: Sfortunata in amore
programme.desc: Una blogger di appuntamenti che scrive sotto lo pseudonimo di Luckless diventa virale per un post su un pessimo incontro con un agente sportivo single. Quando il capo di Winnie le offre una sua rubrica, non ha altra scelta che continuare a uscire con lui per avere materiale.

programme.title: Amore on the road
programme.desc: Abby, conduttrice di un programma di ristrutturazione di ristoranti, ha l'incarico di trasformare un vecchio ristorante in una meta gastronomica. Fuori dal suo elemento, scopre con Tom, il proprietario, la gioia del comfort food, una casa e un possibile amore.

programme.title: Un autunno molto speciale
programme.desc: Gli amici d'infanzia Frankie e Nate si ritrovano a dover dividere un bellissimo vigneto del quale entrambi risultano proprietari e a sfidarsi per poter vincere una competizione autunnale nella quale si eleggerà il miglior vino della regione. La loro rivalità però lascerà ben presto spazio a sentimenti molto più romantici.

programme.title: L'amore in equilibrio
programme.desc: Refugio, sognatore cresciuto in un circo tra magia e poesia, parte dal Messico verso New Orleans alla ricerca del vero amore. L'incontro con Kay, ballerina dal passato oscuro, e con Juan, il padre che non sapeva di avere, intreccia destini, segreti e redenzione in un viaggio di speranza e passione.

programme.desc: Tutta colpa del cioccolato

programme.desc: Un amore di pasticceria

programme.desc: Quello che so sull'amore
